obfuscation_indicators: not necessarily indicative of future results
risk_summary: The disclosure provides substantial quantitative operating, geographic, and segment information, but relies on standard forward-looking disclaimers and conditional language regarding future property sales, capital needs, entitlements, and market conditions. Risk is concentrated in the Austin real estate market and is amplified by cyclical demand, regulatory constraints, inventory depletion, and dependence on future development funding. Reported earnings improvement includes material tax and settlement-related benefits, reducing the apparent quality of recurring earnings.
